name: Hitherfield Will Fall
source:
Something dark has come to Hitherfield and you have been given the opportunity to stop it. You don’t know how many chances you will have, so every decision matters. At midnight, Hitherfield will fall.

[From [url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/witherfield-will-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一些黑暗的东西已经降临到希瑟菲尔德，你有机会阻止它。你不知道自己会有多少机会，所以每一个决定都很重要。午夜时分，希瑟菲尔德将陷落。

[来自[url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/witherfield-will-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
